title: Replay campaign never establishes a successfully consumed authorization
evidence: Replay authorization has resource_precondition_digest [0;32], then ignores the first execute_action result at line 166. src/executor_ipc.rs:167–172 computes the actual precondition using CanonicalHasher; src/executor.rs:1019 checks authorization against it before reservation. The replay match accepts any error at 193.
trigger: Run replay vector against SyntheticResource::new(res_i,100).
impact: A precondition mismatch can reject both calls without exercising replay defense, yet the report records replay rejection as successful adversarial coverage.

title: Crash report declares five tested points without interruption or recovery
evidence: Cohort lines 326–355 synchronously quarantine, verify and destroy each file. No crash injection, restart, recovery operation or durable state reload occurs. Report nevertheless lists PREPARE/QUARANTINE/VERIFY/DISPATCH/COMMIT and SIGKILL_SIMULATED.
trigger: Run the Gate 1 example and consume nemesis-crash-report.json.
impact: PASS_ZERO_AMBIGUOUS_RECOVERIES can be emitted without testing any crash-recovery path, overstating persistence evidence.

title: NEMESIS report passes when all secure-delete operations fail
evidence: Match ignores all results except Committed and SecurityAbort (line 280). PASS_ZERO_TOCTOU_EXPLOITS is based only on unauth_count==0 at 301; no expected count of honest commits or attack rejections is asserted.
trigger: secure_delete returns an infrastructure/error result for every attack and honest operation.
impact: Harness reports security success for a completely nonfunctional deletion path; report cannot distinguish effective enforcement from universal errors.

title: Mock inference panics on a UTF-8 byte boundary
evidence: &prompt[..prompt.len().min(32)] slices a Rust str at byte 32 without checking a character boundary.
trigger: Call MockLocalBackend.infer with 31 ASCII characters followed by a multibyte character.
impact: The mock panics instead of returning Tier3Error, breaking non-ASCII PoC/stress inputs.

title: Attestation digest does not delimit content from model identity
evidence: Hasher updates content bytes followed immediately by model_id bytes, without lengths or separators.
trigger: Compare attested(content="ab", model_id="c") with attested(content="a", model_id="bc").
impact: Different content/model pairs receive identical content_hash without a cryptographic collision; this digest cannot uniquely bind the pair.

title: Async shredder does not initialize its table
evidence: Constructor calls the sync-only _ensure_schema; _ensure_schema_async is defined but never called. shred_fact_async queries is_shredded_async before its try block.
trigger: Use CryptoShredder with a new aiosqlite database then call shred_fact_async.
impact: Raises no-such-table instead of producing a shred result.

title: Audit timestamp uses uptime as Unix time
evidence: datetime.fromtimestamp(time.monotonic(), tz=timezone.utc) interprets a monotonic reference as epoch seconds.
trigger: Call audit_shredding.
impact: Compliance report contains an unrelated historical date.

title: Aeon verifier trusts the public key supplied by the untrusted manifest
evidence: Lines 206-219 construct VerifyingKey exclusively from sovereign_identity.l0_public_key_b64; lines 227-236 make overall_valid depend on that signature and a literal status. Consumer main.rs:519-537 returns success for overall_valid.
trigger: An arbitrary signer supplies a manifest containing its own public key and a signature over its chosen root.
impact: verify-aeon reports successful kernel attestation for an identity never provisioned or trusted by the operator.

title: Aeon identity, claim count and hardware metadata are outside the signature
evidence: Only hex-decoded merkle_root is passed to vk.verify. aeon_id, total_claims_sealed and hardware_uuid are subsequently returned and printed by main.rs:522-534 without cryptographic binding; signed_payload is unused.
trigger: Change an existing valid manifest's aeon_id, total_claims_sealed or hardware_attestation while retaining its root/signature.
impact: The CLI still certifies the modified manifest and prints unverified metadata alongside the valid signature.

title: Identity decryption failure silently overwrites the master identity
evidence: Any exception from load_identity is caught and calls forge_identity. crypto/identity.py:75-106 writes a new random seed to the same master_seed.enc with open(..., w).
trigger: Run the sealer with an existing seed encrypted with a different passphrase or a corrupted seed file.
impact: Destroys the previous private identity and silently rotates signing identity instead of rejecting the sealing operation.

title: Timestamp response existence is mislabeled as authenticated RFC3161 evidence
evidence: AUTHENTICATED_RFC3161_TSA is selected solely by tsr_b64 presence. crypto/rfc3161.py:105-117 base64-encodes any HTTP 200 response without parsing status, signature, certificate trust or message imprint.
trigger: TSA returns HTTP 200 with a rejection response, malformed token, or a token for a different imprint.
impact: Saved artifact claims authenticated timestamp evidence without authenticating its timestamp or binding to the root.

title: New face tracks are returned twice on their first frame
evidence: New tracks are appended at lines 215-216 but never added to matched_tracks; the lost-track loop at 219-224 increments their lost count and appends the same face again. c5_face_swap_cli.py:280 consumes tracker.update assignments.
trigger: Any previously unseen detected face with an assigned identity.
impact: The face is processed twice in one frame and starts with lost=1 despite having just been detected, producing redundant swaps and incorrect extrapolation lifetime.

title: Blur framing fails for sources taller than the output aspect ratio
evidence: scaled_h is computed exclusively from target_w/src_w at 279-281; negative y_offset is used directly for the destination slice at 283-284 without fitting/cropping foreground.
trigger: A portrait source such as 1080x2400 with default 1080x1920 output and mode=blur.
impact: The destination slice cannot accommodate the full foreground array, so NumPy assignment raises a shape error and framing aborts.

title: Handle rejected cold-ledger enqueue results
evidence: All three attestation loops append receipts and ignore enqueue_receipt return values. bounty_cold_ledger.py:109-125 returns False when saturated or closed.
trigger: High-risk receipt while the bounded persistence queue is full or stopped.
impact: Cycle returns a receipt as normal although it was never accepted for persistence.

title: Metadata writes can overwrite another manager’s keys or revocations
evidence: Each KeyManager snapshots the complete JSON at initialization (77-83), then _save_metadata truncates and rewrites that snapshot (85-88), without locking or reloading. generate_and_store_key and revoke_key both invoke it.
trigger: Two manager instances load the same file; one revokes actor A, and the other subsequently generates actor B from its older snapshot.
impact: The second write restores stale revocation metadata and drops intervening updates; process termination during truncation can also leave unreadable metadata.

title: Reject truncated CBOR byte/text strings
evidence: Major bytes/text returns stream.read(val) without requiring len == val. loads also returns after one item without checking trailing data. Static example: 0x43 followed by one byte returns that one byte although length says three.
trigger: Decode a truncated byte/text item.
impact: Malformed serialized input is accepted as a different value; strict framing and integrity callers cannot rely on decoder rejection.

title: Native host dry-run changes executable permissions
evidence: chmod +x "$KERNEL_SCRIPT" runs before the DRY_RUN conditional at lines 132-137.
trigger: Run --dry-run when moskv_native_host.py is not already executable.
impact: A command documented as printing the manifest without writing changes repository file permissions.

title: Container build pins compiler older than workspace manifests
evidence: Builder uses rust:1.80-alpine and copies the entire workspace before cargo build at line 14. Workspace members include 00_ABZU_KERNEL/crates/strike-rs and crates/cadt_mediator, whose manifests declare edition = "2024"; Cargo.lock is version 4.
trigger: Build Dockerfile against this checkout.
impact: Cargo 1.80 cannot parse the 2024 workspace manifests, preventing the image from building. Static manifest incompatibility; build was not run.

title: Two-node quorum failure branch is unreachable
evidence: iter % 50 == 0 is in an else-if following iter % 10 == 0; every multiple of 50 already takes the first branch.
trigger: Run the 1000-cycle consensus example.
impact: No two-node failure is tested, quorum_poisoned_events stays zero, and the concluding BFT certification lacks the advertised rejection-path coverage.

title: Example manifest occupies 128 bytes on the documented 64-bit targets
evidence: repr(C, align(64)) fields place exergy_score at offset 44, insert two bytes before the 4-byte ebr_ticket at 48, then padding[14] ends at 66; size rounds to 128. validate_alignment asserts size==64 at line 38.
trigger: Compile and use this example on macOS/Linux 64-bit targets with normal AtomicU32 alignment.
impact: The advertised 64-byte layout is false and validate_alignment panics when called; copying the example breaks the stated ctypes/shared-memory layout.

title: Simulation announces a verified ZK invariant from a synthetic timing comparison
evidence: Lines 10-18 implement a fixed sleep and an always-true hash expression; lines 75-76 call speedup > 50 a surviving O(1) invariant and report no deadlocks. Targeted references found only the local demo definition/call, not a production proof consumer.
trigger: Running the demo where the synthetic sleep/hash ratio exceeds 50.
impact: Output presents timing of a simulation as falsification of a ZK gate invariant without invoking any proof verifier or testing malformed proofs. Scope output as simulation and remove proof/physical conclusions.

title: Deskimming dry-run writes and replaces its audit receipt
evidence: --dry-run is documented as simulate without writing (111), but audit directories are created at import (30-31) and receipt_file is opened with w unconditionally (102-104).
trigger: Run the script with --dry-run after a prior real receipt exists.
impact: The preview mutates the filesystem and overwrites prior audit evidence with a simulated receipt.

title: Swarm reports successful completion after dropping failed claims
evidence: future.result exceptions are logged and omitted from results; line220 still announces successful closure, and exported JSON contains only successful tasks without failed claim records.
trigger: One or all legion_subagent_task futures raises, for example on a remote client constructor/query exception.
impact: Export and terminal success omit unprocessed claims and cannot distinguish complete from partial remediation.

title: Execution verifier ignores untracked files
evidence: Only git diff and git diff --cached are checked before clean claim.
trigger: Untracked new source or generated output exists with no tracked diff.
impact: Verifier reports clean repository despite uncommitted disk additions.

title: Avoid integer overflow before converting mesh volume to floating point
evidence: mesh_n * mesh_n * mesh_n is evaluated as usize before conversion to f64. Module is publicly exported by src/lib.rs:99.
trigger: On 64-bit targets, mesh_n=4194304 makes mesh_n cubed equal 2^66, beyond usize.
impact: The public calculation panics with overflow checks or wraps (to zero for this input) without them, returning an incorrect floor.

title: Folder prefix example uses an unbounded lexical lower bound
evidence: The documented starts-with filter contains only operator gte, value docs/api/, with no upper bound or separate prefix predicate.
trigger: Apply the example to a collection also containing lexically later unrelated folders, such as docs/zzz/ or private/.
impact: A greater-than-or-equal comparison does not enforce the claimed prefix and can include unrelated retrieval results. This is a docs/example filter defect, not a demonstrated tenant authorization boundary.

title: Polymeter selector has no effect on generated rhythm
evidence: Dialog exposes fixed-bar polyrhythm versus continuous polymeter at line 60 and apply forwards mode at line 108, but generate_euclidean never reads mode and scales both patterns to BAR.
trigger: Select Polimetro Continuo in the dialog.
impact: Output remains identical to fixed-bar mode; the offered polymeter feature is absent.

title: ASAR scanner example returns an already closed stream
evidence: scan_asar opens f with a with block at41 and returns f at57; downstream example line138 calls f.seek.
trigger: Use the documented scan_asar return stream in its documented IPC extraction loop.
impact: The with context closes f before the caller receives it, so extraction raises ValueError instead of scanning the archive.

title: Directory linter skips arbitrary source paths containing build or dist
evidence: audit_directory tests ignored substrings against the entire root path and returns no violations for skipped roots; main lines 157-159 prints compliance and exits zero for an empty result.
trigger: Audit a source tree under a path such as /tmp/build-review/src or /tmp/distribution-ui containing frontend violations.
impact: All matching directories silently escape inspection and the tool reports compliance. Match directory components and report empty coverage explicitly.
